shortlist.label: leukemia cutis
shortlist.why_kept: violaceous cutaneous lesions and atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: multiple myeloma
shortlist.why_kept: diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities in bone marrow and high white blood cell count in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: neurocysticercosis
shortlist.why_kept: severe flaccid quadriparesis and reduced muscle stretch reflexes with nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots

shortlist.label: spinal cord compression
shortlist.why_kept: symmetric lower extremity weakness and urinary retention with abnormalities in MRI of lumbosacral spine

shortlist.label: meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: high white blood cell count and atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid with severe flaccid quadriparesis

raw.rationale: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions, severe flaccid quadriparesis, reduced muscle stretch reflexes, and atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid, along with nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots, are highly suggestive of leukemia cutis, which is a rare extramedullary manifestation of leukemia.

rejected.label: multiple myeloma
rejected.why: While multiple myeloma can cause bone marrow abnormalities and nerve root compression, the presence of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid and violaceous cutaneous lesions are more indicative of leukemia cutis.

rejected.label: neurocysticercosis
rejected.why: Neurocysticercosis typically presents with seizures, headaches, and focal neurologic deficits, which are not consistent with the patient's symptoms of symmetric lower extremity weakness and urinary retention.

rejected.label: spinal cord compression
rejected.why: Spinal cord compression can cause lower extremity weakness and urinary retention, but the presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions and atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid suggest a more systemic disease process, such as leukemia cutis.

rejected.label: meningitis
rejected.why: Meningitis can cause symptoms such as headache, fever, and stiff neck, which are not mentioned in the case, and the presence of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid is more suggestive of a malignant process, such as leukemia cutis.
